q: Logspace randomness (RL) and derandomization: Saks-Zhou (1999) showed RL ⊆ DSPACE(log^{3/2} n). The Reingold (2008) result went further, proving:
opts: RL = L (undirected graph reachability is in deterministic logspace)
exp: Reingold's theorem (2008): undirected ST-connectivity (USTCON) is in L (deterministic logspace), proving RL ⊆ L, hence RL = L. The proof uses Cayley graph expanders and iterative squaring of the graph to amplify expansion. This is a complete derandomization of USTCON.
